results.title: Spain installs floating barrier in Ceuta after calm night following border rush
results.description: Spain has begun installing a 500-metre floating barrier off Ceuta after a mass migrant crossing left at least 67 people dead, while EU governments push for an emergency meeting on the border crisis.
